command:
bash -lc '
set -u
SYSLOG=/tmp/server/var/log/syslog
APPLOG=/tmp/server/var/log/app.log
printf "=== FILE CHECKS ===\n"
for f in "$SYSLOG" "$APPLOG"; do
  if [ -r "$f" ]; then printf "readable: %s (%s bytes)\n" "$f" "$(wc -c < "$f")"; else printf "MISSING/UNREADABLE: %s\n" "$f"; fi
done

printf "\n=== OOM KILLER EVENTS ===\n"
if [ -r "$SYSLOG" ]; then
  grep -inE "oom-killer|out of memory|out_of_memory|killed process|oom_reaper|memory cgroup out of memory" "$SYSLOG" || echo "No matching OOM signatures found."
else echo "syslog unavailable"; fi

printf "\n=== ZOMBIE/DEFUNCT PROCESSES ===\n"
printf "state pid ppid comm args\n"
ps -eo state=,pid=,ppid=,comm=,args= | awk '\''$1 ~ /^Z/ || $0 ~ /<defunct>/ {print}'\'' || true
ZCOUNT=$(ps -eo stat= | awk '\''$1 ~ /^Z/ {n++} END {print n+0}'\'')
printf "Zombie count: %s\n" "$ZCOUNT"

printf "\n=== LAST 100 APPLICATION LOG LINES ===\n"
if [ -r "$APPLOG" ]; then
  tail -n 100 "$APPLOG"
else echo "app.log unavailable"; fi

printf "\n=== DATABASE TIMEOUT MATCHES IN LAST 100 LINES ===\n"
if [ -r "$APPLOG" ]; then
  tail -n 100 "$APPLOG" | grep -inE "(database|db|sql|postgres|mysql|mongo|redis).*(timeout|timed out|connection refused|connection reset|too many connections)|(timeout|timed out).*(database|db|sql|postgres|mysql|mongo|redis)|connect(etion)? timeout|pool.*(exhaust|timeout)|acquire.*timeout" || echo "No database connection-timeout patterns found in last 100 lines."
else echo "app.log unavailable"; fi

printf "\n=== WORKSPACE DISK USAGE ===\n"
df -h /home/node/.openclaw/workspace
printf "\nWorkspace directory summary:\n"
du -sh /home/node/.openclaw/workspace 2>/dev/null || true
'

curl -L --fail --silent --show-error 'https://www.irena.org/-/media/Files/IRENA/Agency/Publication/2023/Aug/IRENA_Renewable_power_generation_costs_in_2022.pdf' -o /tmp/research/irena_2023_costs.pdf && pdftotext -layout /tmp/research/irena_2023_costs.pdf /tmp/research/irena_2023_costs.txt && grep -in -E 'offshore wind|solar photovoltaic|solar PV|LCOE' /tmp/research/irena_2023_costs.txt | head -80
